about.title: About Rumble Challenge
about.description: A tool created to facilitate and make character team draws more fun, offering different configurations, bans, and game modes.
about.footer: Independent project developed for the community.

howItWorks.title: How it works?
howItWorks.description: Configure the number of characters, choose the desired bans, and press the draw button. The system will automatically select a valid team respecting all configurations.

challenge.title: Challenge Mode
challenge.description: In Challenge Mode, the drawn characters are added to the global bans after each draw. In this way, the following teams must use different characters.

draw.title: Team Draws
draw.description: Generate random teams automatically among the available characters.

drawSettings.title: Draw Settings
drawSettings.description: Choose the number of characters and the speed of the draw animation.

globalBans.title: Global Bans
globalBans.description: Remove specific characters from all draws.

individualBans.title: Individual Bans
individualBans.description: Define which characters cannot occupy certain positions in the team.

challengeMode.title: Challenge Mode
challengeMode.description: Avoid repeating characters between consecutive draws by automatically adding the drawn characters to the bans.

history.title: Draw History
history.description: Check the teams that were drawn previously.

languages.title: Multiple Languages
languages.description: Use the application in different languages through the language selector.
